reviews.title: Amazing Case
reviews.comment:
This case is amazing and is perfectly manufactured.
It took me about an hour or so but it was so easy to install my parts into this case and the best part is the look it is absolutely breath taking to look and at I'm not really good with wire ties but it doesn't matter with this case you have so much space in the back you can just tuck and zip tire them behind everything. The power supply sites behind the mother board and the Storage as well which allows the main components to be showcased from the inside. And it looks amazing with the glass wall letting you see inside of the case. If you are thinking about upgrading or making a whole new build this is the case to get for sure I love it.

reviews.title: Looks Great, Stays Cool — This Case Is a Beast
reviews.comment:
I’ve built a lot of systems over the years, and let’s be honest — most pre-installed case fans are hot garbage. I usually toss them immediately. But with this case? I bought upgrade fans and never even opened the box. The included fans are surprisingly quiet, powerful, and actually push air like they mean it. That alone impressed me.
The design is fantastic. Glass panels on the side give it that high-end look, and the wider layout (thanks to the side-mounted power supply) gives you more room to breathe — literally and figuratively. It's noticeably roomier than your standard tower, which means better airflow and much easier cable routing.
Speaking of which, cable management in this case is a dream. Tons of access points and space to tuck things away. I didn’t have to fight with it or jam wires into awkward corners. Everything just fit.
The airflow is absolutely excellent. My components are staying cool even under load, and the interior looks clean and sharp thanks to the layout. It’s the kind of build that actually makes you want to show off your rig.
Pros:
Gorgeous tempered glass panels
Side-mounted PSU means more width and space
Shockingly good pre-installed fans
Excellent airflow
Easy, clean cable management
Cons:
Slightly wider than standard cases (not a problem unless you’re low on desk space)
If you want a case that’s both functional and good-looking, this is one of the best I’ve worked with in a while. Would absolutely buy again — and I say that as someone who usually ends up modding everything.
reviews.author: Thomas P. Ulrick

reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.comment: The case looks amazing once everything is set up, but the building process had a few challenges. Installing the motherboard was a bit tricky, and connecting the fans wasn’t as straightforward as expected. Also, the GPU bracket didn’t come with any screws, which made things slightly harder. That said, it all came together nicely in the end. I’d rate it a 7.5 out of 10 and recommend it for anyone doing a budget build.
